column4: body_match is three-valued: TRUE (bytes after the package line identical to the donor's), TYPES (identical after the declared TYPE renames, the only edit this recipe makes inside a body), FALSE; a rename MIndex* -> M3* can never be TRUE, and a FALSE would mean an import rewrite or an undeclared change
